summary: Implemented the speed indicator for unknown-total progress tasks. Changes: rich/progress.py (TaskProgressColumn show_speed option, static render_speed using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, render branch for unknown totals; track() show_speed param passed to the column; Progress.track infers total from Sized sequences with no ValueError for unsized iterables); CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added line; tests/test_progress.py: removed the two ValueError assertions and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), per instructions, and nothing was committed. Note: Progress.get_default_columns is unchanged, so its TaskProgressColumn defaults to show_speed off.
